race.comment: KURSAAL (14) is the danger third-up, having worked home evenly for fourth at Goulburn after being bumped at the start, and her Wyong run prior was better than the market expected. DANNY'S OCEAN (5) is a Casino Prince gelding who makes his debut for the Singleton yard. Has impressed in the two trials and gets his chance in a thin contest. BOA VISTA (4) has finished runner up in her two starts for the new yard and can go one better today despite drawing out. FAKE FICTION (15) first run for the Wes Boyd yard she was beaten just over three lengths at Scone. Fitter now and can run into the minor money.
